metadata.title: The Coefficient of the a0-Lambda Relation: a Zero-Mode Theorem for Local MOND Actions, Two Failed Repairs, a Four-Form Reframing, and an H0 Degeneracy
metadata.description:
This review copy examines whether a specified class of local covariant MOND actions derives the empirical relation a0 = κ c √(G ρΛ). A normalization zero mode leaves the two scales independent, and the tested scalar-vacuum and global-constraint constructions do not remove the required free choice. The four-form construction makes the square-root scaling structural but leaves a coupling ratio.

Version 2 withdraws the earlier stability claim and its Gaia DR4 wide-binary shift: the slaved scalar force folds near gN/a0 = 2.39 and is unstable up to the switch-off near 155. The solar switch-off radius is about 640 AU, correcting 205 AU in version 1. The updated review copy distinguishes the historical distance-free estimate 0.551 ± 0.043 and its conditional likelihood/H0 calculations from the current shape-only record, κB = 0.5470 with combined uncertainty 0.1747. Historical and current acceleration-scale footings are labelled separately. Amendment 13 is proposed and has not been filed.

The result is scoped to the displayed action and the constructions examined. It supplies neither a derivation of κ = 1/2 nor a healthy four-form completion. The original theorem, proof paragraph and displayed equations are preserved in this review copy. Computation scripts and the stability correction are available in the research repository; no new global likelihood or H0 posterior is claimed. AI-assisted research draft; not peer reviewed.
